source_metadata.dataset: Local Authority Land and Building Assets

field_evidence.type_use: Official rows expose PropertyName, OtherDetail and HoldingType; rows include Buildings, Land/Buildings and Land labels plus named uses.
field_evidence.footprint: The CSV schema has no footprint geometry field; only optional WGS84 GeoX/GeoY point coordinates and scalar BuildingSize/LandArea fields.
field_evidence.identifier: Official AssetCode is present for all processed rows; UPRN is present where supplied by Trafford Council.
field_evidence.window: Exactly source records 1-50 after the header were evaluated; first AssetCode TMBC0001/T0000003 and last AssetCode TMBC0050.

exact_blocker: Official Trafford Council transparency CSV rows 1-50 provide asset identifiers, names, holding/use classification, optional WGS84 point coordinates and building size, but no Polygon/MultiPolygon/WKT/GeoJSON footprint geometry. Point coordinates and area scalars cannot be promoted to building footprints; all 50 source records are rejected at the footprint gate and no parcel/materialization progress is claimed.
